rows: Computation tree — nodes are computation states, branches are transitions; backward induction is exactly the tree-recursion pattern (base case at leaves, combine upward)
Indistinguishable states in partial-information search (POMDP belief states, imperfect-information game trees in alpha-beta pruning)
Well-defined recursive subproblem — SPE is optimal substructure (Bellman) applied to strategic games
Dynamic programming: solve leaves first, propagate values up; non-credible threats are sub-optimal sub-solutions that disappear under DP
Bayes' theorem applied at each information set — identical to exact inference in a directed graphical model along an observed path
State machine with two states (cooperate / punish) and a one-way transition; the "no recovery" property is a design choice enforcing Nash credibility
Discount factor threshold is a capacity-planning condition: sustained cooperation requires the future to be heavy enough to outweigh one-shot defection gain

Eliminates strategies with "dead code" — beliefs about unreached information sets must be consistent and on-path strategies must be best responses given those beliefs; analogous to liveness + safety invariants in concurrent systems
